resolution: Generation 1 is accepted only for the deterministic repository-hosted dashboard capability/audit component. The implementation reuses the pre-existing dashboard policy as its capability authority, adds exact audit/visibility bindings and fail-closed stale-snapshot execution evidence, and explicitly does not promote physical sensor, host/VPS runtime, provider/VLM, GRID10, GWT, J-Space, effect, completion or whole-system runtime claims.
next_exact_action: Do not reopen F2-WP-713 absent executable counterevidence or a deliberate successor contract. Route around the already-active F2-WP-714 sustained multi-source acceptance lane; only its owner should mutate that workpackage.
